_note: Pre-recorded analysis of the demo files in demo/files, in the same format as model output. Used only for the demo when no model key is set, and validated by the same evidence rules.
success_condition_basis: Both POST /api/orders requests in network.har returned 500 with PAYMENT_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT, and the session notes say no order number appeared.

findings.evidence: Two POST requests to /api/orders returned status 500 with {"error":"PAYMENT_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT"}, and no confirmation page request follows them.
findings.impact: The customer cannot place the order, so the journey stops at order confirmation and the sale is lost.
findings.recommendation: Fix the payment gateway timeout in the test environment, and show a clear state on payment failure with an alternative payment option.
findings.title: Order confirmation fails on a payment-gateway timeout
findings.standard: ISO 9241-11:2018 — Effectiveness · Nielsen heuristic #9: Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors

findings.evidence: Tester note: “بعد إعادة تحميل الصفحة للمحاولة مجددًا، كانت حقول عنوان الشحن فارغة” (after reloading to retry, the shipping address fields were empty).
findings.impact: Customer data is lost after the error, raising the chance of abandoning the order.
findings.recommendation: Keep the address in the session and restore it automatically after a failed order confirmation.
findings.title: Address data is lost after the error
findings.standard: Nielsen heuristic #5: Error prevention · WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.7 Redundant Entry (A)

findings.evidence: The only visible error message is “حدث خطأ، حاول مرة أخرى” (an error occurred, try again), with no reason or next step.
findings.impact: The customer does not know whether they were charged or what to do, and retries with difficulty.
findings.recommendation: Replace the generic message with one stating the payment did not go through and nothing was charged, with buttons to retry or change the payment method.
findings.title: Generic error message with no cause or next step
findings.standard: Nielsen heuristic #9: Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors · WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.3 Error Suggestion (AA)
findings.code: Payment did not go through and you were not charged.

findings.evidence: The phone and postal_code fields in the shipping form have no label or aria-label and rely on placeholder only. The icon-close button has no text name.
findings.impact: Screen-reader users cannot tell what the two fields are for and fill the address with difficulty.
findings.recommendation: Add labels linked to phone and postal_code, and an aria-label to the close button.
findings.title: Fields without labels and an unnamed button
findings.standard: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A) · WCAG 2.2 SC 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)
findings.code:
<label for="phone">Mobile</label>
<input id="phone" name="phone" type="tel" autocomplete="tel">
<button class="icon-close" aria-label="Close">…</button>

findings.evidence: The order summary shows “رسوم الشحن: تُحسب عند الدفع” (shipping: calculated at payment) and “45 ر.س + الشحن”, while the expected feature is showing shipping cost before payment.
findings.impact: The customer does not see the final total before paying, which weakens trust and adds hesitation.
findings.recommendation: Calculate shipping once the city is chosen and show the final total before the confirm button.
findings.title: Shipping cost is not shown before payment
findings.standard: Nielsen heuristic #1: Visibility of system status · ISO 9241-11:2018 — Effectiveness

findings.evidence: The checkout page has no field, button or text for a discount code.
findings.impact: Customers with a discount code cannot use it, but can still buy at full price.
findings.recommendation: Add a discount code field to the order summary before payment.
findings.title: No discount code field

findings.evidence: Tester note: the “المتابعة بدون حساب” (continue without an account) option is a small text link below the sign-in form; it took about 20 seconds to find.
findings.impact: A delay in reaching guest checkout, without blocking the task.
findings.recommendation: Show “continue without an account” as a primary button next to sign-in.
findings.title: Guest checkout option is hard to find
findings.standard: Nielsen heuristic #6: Recognition rather than recall · ISO 9241-11:2018 — Efficiency
findings.code: Continue without an account

missing_analytics_events.when: When the shipping address is saved in step 4
missing_analytics_events.why: POST /api/checkout/address succeeded with 200 in network.har, but no request to analytics.nakheel.test/collect carrying add_shipping_info followed.

missing_analytics_events.when: When a payment method is chosen in step 5
missing_analytics_events.why: Neither network.har nor the dataLayer in checkout.html sends this event, even though a payment method was chosen.

missing_analytics_events.when: When the order confirmation page appears
missing_analytics_events.why: The confirmation page never appeared because /api/orders failed, so the event was not sent. Re-check after the payment fix.

insufficient_evidence: The order confirmation page (step 6) was not attached, so its content and the order number cannot be judged.

The console error “Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'shippingZone')” and the 400 on /api/shipping/rates?city= point to a shipping calculation defect, but the evidence does not show its exact visible effect on the customer.
